name: get_summary
title: Hardware summary
description: One compact reading of the whole PC: CPU temperature, load and power; every GPU's temperature, load, VRAM, power and fan; RAM; the busiest processes. Call this first.

name: get_cpu
title: CPU detail
description: CPU model, temperature (Tctl and per CCD on AMD), package power, total load and the load of every logical processor.

name: get_gpus
title: GPU detail
description: Every NVIDIA GPU (index as nvidia-smi counts them): temperature, hotspot and memory temperature, core and memory-controller load, VRAM used/free/total, power and limit, clock, fan.

index.description: Only this GPU. Omit for all.

name: get_memory
title: Memory detail
description: Physical RAM, commit charge and page file, in GB.

name: get_sensors
title: Motherboard sensors
description: Motherboard temperatures (including thermistor probes) and fan speeds with their labels and ids.

name: get_processes
title: Top processes
description: The six processes using the most CPU (percent of the whole CPU) and the six using the most memory (private GB), grouped by program name.

name: get_snapshot
title: Raw snapshot
description: The full raw hwcast snapshot (api 1 schema, the same JSON mods receive). Larger than the other tools; prefer them unless you need every field.

name: list_metrics
title: List metrics
description: Every metric name this PC offers, with its unit and current value. Use these names with sample and wait_for.

name: sample
title: Sample metrics
description: Watch metrics for a few seconds (one reading per second) and return min, average, max and last for each. Better than one reading when loads fluctuate.

metrics.description: Names from list_metrics, e.g. gpu0.load, cpu.temp. Default: CPU temperature and load, and each GPU's temperature, load, VRAM used and power.

name: check_gpu_free
title: Check GPU free
description: Decide whether a GPU is free for new work: watches every GPU for a few seconds and reports average and peak load, minimum free VRAM and a free/busy verdict for each, plus the best free GPU.

max_load_pct.description: A GPU whose peak load stays at or below this counts as idle.

need_vram_gb.description: VRAM the job needs, GB. Default 0.

name: wait_for
title: Wait for a condition
description: Block until a metric stays below or above a threshold for hold_seconds in a row, or until the timeout. For example wait until gpu0.load is below 5 (a job finished) or gpu1.temp is below 50.

below.description: Condition: value is below this. Give below or above.
